name: Papa Daisuki! to Itte Kure... ~Hankouki no Musume o Saimin Appli de Kyouai Shitsuke~
original_name: パパ大好き！と言ってくれ…～反抗期の娘を催眠アプリで狂愛しつけ～
source: Yasuaki's wife believes that it's a difficult time so it's better to leave it alone, but... his daughter Erica has been avoiding him lately. One day, Yasuaki obtained a hypnosis app by chance. He thinks it's probably a fake, but decides to try it on Erica anyway...
